user.title: Add an IKEA OBEGRÄNSAD lamp
user.description: Enter the IP address or host name of a lamp running the ph1p/ikea-led-obegraensad firmware. A DHCP reservation for the lamp is recommended.

data_description.host: For example 192.168.100.45. The lamp's web interface must open at http://<host>/.
The new IP address or host name of the same lamp.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the lamp. Check the address and that the lamp is powered and on the network.
error.invalid_response: The device answered, but not like an OBEGRÄNSAD lamp.
error.firmware_unsupported: The lamp's firmware has no /api/info route. Update it to the current ph1p/ikea-led-obegraensad firmware.

abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different lamp.

data.max_lamp_messages: Messages kept on the lamp at once
data.restore: Restore the previous plugin after a temporary display
data.night_suppress_low: Drop low-priority notifications while the night brightness is active

data_description.poll_interval: How often /api/info is read. Live changes arrive over the WebSocket; the poll refreshes the diagnostic sensors and detects outages.
data_description.message_delay: Milliseconds per scroll step. Lower is faster.
data_description.message_repeat: Extra showings after the first, once per minute. -1 repeats until removed.
data_description.max_lamp_messages: The lamp holds 10 messages and silently drops more. Further messages wait in Home Assistant.
data_description.restore: Default for the restore option of show_icon, draw_frame, show_graph and clear.
data_description.night_suppress_low: Uses the lamp's own night brightness schedule.
data_description.ddp_port: The firmware listens on 4048. Change only for a modified firmware.

persist_plugin.name: Make current plugin the startup plugin

communication_error.message: Could not talk to the lamp: {error}

firmware_unsupported.message: The lamp's firmware lacks the required API, please update it.

websocket_required.message: This command needs the lamp's WebSocket connection, which is down right now.

not_ready.message: The lamp state is not known yet.

unknown_plugin.message: The lamp has no plugin named "{name}".

schedule_times_equal.message: Start and end time of the night schedule must differ.

schedule_empty.message: The plugin schedule is empty. Set one first.

no_target.message: No IKEA OBEGRÄNSAD lamp matches the target.

unreachable.title: {title} has been unreachable for a while
unreachable.description: Home Assistant cannot reach the lamp at {host} for more than 30 minutes. Check that it has power and Wi-Fi. If its address changed, give it a DHCP reservation and update the address with **Reconfigure** on the integration page.

firmware_unsupported.title: Firmware of {title} is too old
firmware_unsupported.description: The lamp at {host} has no /api/info route. Flash the current ph1p/ikea-led-obegraensad firmware, then reload the integration.

select_plugin.name: Select plugin
select_plugin.description: Switches the lamp to a plugin by name. Stops a running plugin schedule, like the lamp's web interface does.

plugin.name: Plugin
plugin.description: Plugin name as shown by the Plugin select, e.g. Weather or Big Clock.

set_brightness_schedule.name: Set night brightness schedule
set_brightness_schedule.description: Changes the lamp's own night brightness schedule. Fields left out keep their current value.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turns the schedule on or off.

end.name: End
end.description: When it ends. May be after midnight.

set_plugin_schedule.name: Set plugin schedule
set_plugin_schedule.description: Stores a rotation of plugins on the lamp, or starts, stops or clears it.

action.name: Action
action.description: set stores the list and starts it; start, stop and clear act on the stored list.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: List of plugin names with durations in seconds, used by set.
